name: Computer Networks
description: OSI and TCP/IP stack, routing protocols, flow & congestion control, DNS, and TLS/HTTPS.

questions.prompt: During the TCP 3-way handshake, which flags are exchanged between client and server?
questions.explanation: The client sends SYN, the server replies with SYN-ACK, and the client acknowledges with ACK to establish a full-duplex connection.

questions.prompt: Which protocol translates an IP address into a physical hardware MAC address on a local area network?
questions.explanation: ARP broadcasts on the local network to discover the Layer 2 MAC address associated with a given Layer 3 IP address.
